description.value: A psychometric battery characterizing cognitive functioning, including immediate, delayed, and recognition memory; simple and choice reaction time; Stroop performance; and forward and backward digit span. Performance measures were converted to z scores relative to younger adults and averaged into a single cognitive composite score, which was used to examine individual differences in brain activation during reappraisal while controlling for age.

spans.text: As tests of memory, they viewed a series of 16 words on a computer screen and read each word aloud. At the end of the series, they verbally recalled as many of those words as possible (‘Immediate Memory’ task). After a 20-min delay, participants again recalled as many words as they could (‘Delayed Memory’ task). Thereafter, participants completed a ‘Recognition Memory’ task in which the 16 target words and 16 lure words were presented on a computer screen. Participants evaluated whether each word was ‘old’ (e.g. from the original list) or ‘new’.
